# The Wine Goat

> The Wine Goat (thewinegoat.com) is an independent online platform and app to prepare the WSET Level 3 Award in Wines exam (WSET 3), in English, Italian, French and Spanish. It is not affiliated with the Wine & Spirit Education Trust.

Key facts:
- 2,000+ WSET Level 3 style multiple-choice practice questions with explanations, organised by the 28 topics of the syllabus (Bordeaux, Burgundy, Champagne, Rhône, Italy, Spain, Germany, New World, sherry, port, viticulture, winemaking, SAT tasting).
- 101 short written answer (open) questions, marked instantly against the key points, each with a model answer.
- Mock exams (multiple choice + written answers + SAT tasting note), 2,500+ flashcards, 11 games, 68 animated wine lessons, 45 podcast episodes, 42 interactive maps, 127 grape variety sheets, a wine dictionary.
- Personalised study plan: the user sets goal (Pass, Merit, Distinction), exam date, minutes per day and course days; the app builds a day-by-day plan, tracks mastery and resurfaces weak points.
- Notes: photograph lecture notes or record and transcribe a lesson.
- Free: the full Bordeaux module, flashcards, games and the study plan. Paid access unlocks the rest (one-off price, no subscription).
- The WSET Level 3 exam: theory = 50 multiple-choice questions + 4 short written answer questions; tasting = blind tasting of 2 wines with the Systematic Approach to Tasting (SAT); 55% needed in each part; results Pass, Merit or Distinction.

## WSET Level 1 and Level 2 (app coming soon)
- WSET Level 1 Award in Wines: 30 multiple-choice questions in 45 minutes, 70% to pass, about 6 hours of guided learning, no prerequisites.
- WSET Level 2 Award in Wines: 50 multiple-choice questions in 60 minutes, 55% to pass, about 28 hours of study (16 guided), 8 principal + 22 regional grape varieties, 70+ geographical indications.
- [WSET Level 1 guide](https://thewinegoat.com/wset-level-1/) · [Livello 1](https://thewinegoat.com/it/wset-livello-1/) · [Niveau 1](https://thewinegoat.com/fr/wset-niveau-1/) · [Nivel 1](https://thewinegoat.com/es/wset-nivel-1/)
- [WSET Level 2 guide](https://thewinegoat.com/wset-level-2/) · [Livello 2](https://thewinegoat.com/it/wset-livello-2/) · [Niveau 2](https://thewinegoat.com/fr/wset-niveau-2/) · [Nivel 2](https://thewinegoat.com/es/wset-nivel-2/)

- [QCM WSET niveau 3 : questions d'examen avec réponses](https://thewinegoat.com/fr/qcm-wset-niveau-3/): QCM WSET 3 gratuits avec réponses et explications : questions d'examen sur les régions, les cépages, la vinification et la SAT. Plus de 2 000 dans l'appli, en français.
- [Preguntas de examen WSET nivel 3 con respuestas](https://thewinegoat.com/es/preguntas-examen-wset-3/): Preguntas de examen WSET 3 gratis con respuestas y explicaciones: test de opción múltiple sobre regiones, uvas, vinificación y la cata SAT.
- [WSET Level 3 mock exam: free practice test](https://thewinegoat.com/wset-level-3-mock-exam/): Take a free WSET Level 3 mock exam: timed multiple-choice questions with instant marking and explanations. Full timed mock exams with written answers and tasting in the app.
- [Simulazione d'esame WSET Livello 3 gratis](https://thewinegoat.com/it/simulazione-esame-wset-3/): Fai una simulazione d'esame WSET 3 gratis: domande a scelta multipla con correzione immediata e spiegazioni. Simulazioni complete a tempo con domande scritte e degustazione nell'app.
- [Examen blanc WSET niveau 3 gratuit](https://thewinegoat.com/fr/examen-blanc-wset-3/): Passez un examen blanc WSET 3 gratuit : QCM corrigés instantanément avec explications. Examens blancs complets chronométrés avec questions rédigées et dégustation dans l'appli.
- [Simulacro de examen WSET nivel 3 gratis](https://thewinegoat.com/es/simulacro-examen-wset-3/): Haz un simulacro de examen WSET 3 gratis: preguntas de opción múltiple corregidas al instante con explicaciones. Simulacros completos con preguntas escritas y cata en la app.
- [WSET Level 3 short written answer questions: examples and model answers](https://thewinegoat.com/wset-level-3-short-answer-questions/): How to answer WSET Level 3 short written answer questions: real examples with the points that score marks, model answers and instant marking in the app.
- [Domande a risposta breve WSET Livello 3: esempi e risposte modello](https://thewinegoat.com/it/domande-aperte-wset-3/): Come rispondere alle domande aperte del WSET 3: esempi veri con gli elementi che danno punti, risposte modello e correzione immediata nell'app.
- [Questions à réponse courte WSET niveau 3 : exemples et réponses types](https://thewinegoat.com/fr/questions-ouvertes-wset-3/): Comment répondre aux questions ouvertes du WSET 3 : vrais exemples avec les éléments qui rapportent des points, réponses types et correction immédiate dans l'appli.
- [Preguntas de respuesta corta WSET nivel 3: ejemplos y respuestas modelo](https://thewinegoat.com/es/preguntas-abiertas-wset-3/): Cómo responder las preguntas abiertas del WSET 3: ejemplos con los elementos que dan puntos, respuestas modelo y corrección inmediata en la app.
- [The WSET Level 3 Systematic Approach to Tasting (SAT): how to write a tasting note](https://thewinegoat.com/wset-systematic-approach-to-tasting/): How to use the WSET Level 3 SAT for the blind tasting exam: appearance, nose, palate and conclusions, quality and readiness for drinking, with practice questions.
- [L'approccio sistematico alla degustazione (SAT) del WSET 3: come scrivere la nota](https://thewinegoat.com/it/degustazione-sat-wset/): Come usare il SAT del WSET Livello 3 per la degustazione d'esame: aspetto, naso, palato e conclusioni, qualità e prontezza, con domande di allenamento.
- [L'approche systématique de la dégustation (SAT) du WSET 3 : rédiger sa note](https://thewinegoat.com/fr/degustation-sat-wset/): Utiliser la SAT du WSET niveau 3 pour la dégustation d'examen : aspect, nez, bouche et conclusions, qualité et potentiel, avec des questions d'entraînement.
- [El enfoque sistemático de cata (SAT) del WSET 3: cómo escribir la nota](https://thewinegoat.com/es/cata-sat-wset/): Cómo usar el SAT del WSET nivel 3 en la cata del examen: aspecto, nariz, boca y conclusiones, calidad y potencial de guarda.
- [WSET Level 3 flashcards: grapes, regions, numbers and key terms](https://thewinegoat.com/wset-level-3-flashcards/): Free WSET Level 3 flashcards: grape varieties, regions, appellations, winemaking terms and the numbers to know. 2,500+ cards with spaced repetition in the app.
- [Flashcard WSET Livello 3: vitigni, regioni, cifre e termini](https://thewinegoat.com/it/flashcard-wset-3/): Flashcard WSET 3 gratis: vitigni, regioni, denominazioni, termini di vinificazione e le cifre da sapere. Oltre 2.500 carte con ripetizione dilazionata nell'app.
- [Flashcards WSET niveau 3 : cépages, régions, chiffres et vocabulaire](https://thewinegoat.com/fr/flashcards-wset-3/): Flashcards WSET 3 gratuites : cépages, régions, appellations, termes de vinification et chiffres à connaître. Plus de 2 500 cartes avec répétition espacée dans l'appli.
- [Flashcards WSET nivel 3: uvas, regiones, cifras y términos](https://thewinegoat.com/es/flashcards-wset-3/): Flashcards WSET 3 gratis: variedades de uva, regiones, denominaciones, términos de vinificación y cifras clave. Más de 2.500 tarjetas con repetición espaciada en la app.
- [How to pass WSET Level 3 first time: study plan and tips](https://thewinegoat.com/how-to-pass-wset-level-3/): How to pass the WSET Level 3 Award in Wines: how the exam works, how many hours to study, a week-by-week study plan, tips for MCQs, written answers and the SAT tasting.
- [Come superare il WSET Livello 3 al primo tentativo: piano di studio e consigli](https://thewinegoat.com/it/come-superare-wset-3/): Come passare il WSET Level 3 Award in Wines: com'è fatto l'esame, quante ore studiare, un piano di studio settimana per settimana, consigli per crocette, domande scritte e degustazione SAT.
- [Réussir le WSET niveau 3 du premier coup : plan de révision et conseils](https://thewinegoat.com/fr/reussir-wset-niveau-3/): Comment réussir le WSET Level 3 Award in Wines : déroulé de l'examen, heures de travail, plan de révision semaine par semaine, conseils pour les QCM, les questions rédigées et la dégustation SAT.
- [Cómo aprobar el WSET nivel 3 a la primera: plan de estudio y consejos](https://thewinegoat.com/es/como-aprobar-wset-3/): Cómo aprobar el WSET Level 3 Award in Wines: cómo es el examen, cuántas horas estudiar, un plan semana a semana y consejos para el test, las preguntas escritas y la cata SAT.
